findings.location: ch08 Def c8-2pt (eq. lines 474-478) with Thm c8-adjoint (Ward-identity hypothesis, line 505) and Def c8-inner; inherited by inner_product_design.tex Rem ip-spin (line 153), Prop ip-tree, Prop ip-konishi, Prop ip-twenty, Prop ip-weight3, Thm ip-logic (i); engine_plan_ip.json conventions_to_fix_in_code.two_point (line 38), signs_recorded[2] (line 43), gate G0.1 (line 96), open_items[0] (line 269); two_point_design.tex def:t-2pt (eq:t-def) with thm:t-ward (eq:t-ward)
findings.claim: The two-point function of Def c8-2pt (d_{t2} d_{t1} W with the odd parameters written on the left, 'the coefficient of t1 t2') equals (-1)^{|O1||O2|} times the expectation hbar d_P(O1 O2) with O1 on the left. On fermionic families (O_zeta, the 20 at weight 5/2, Fbar_w) it is therefore negative definite, and for an odd generator Y it satisfies <Lambda(Y)F,G> = -(-1)^{|Y|(|F|+1)} <F,Lambda(Y)G>, which is the opposite of the hypothesis <Lambda(Y)F,G> = -(-1)^{|Y||F|} <F,Lambda(Y)G> of Thm c8-adjoint (the hypothesis is the Ward identity of the expectation form; even generators are unaffected). Cor c8-gram, Thm ip-graded and the test equations T0-T3 hold for the expectation form only. Combining them with the literal Def c8-2pt values gives a contradiction at tree level (T0 would require tau sigma = +2, against the representation property tau sigma = -2) and T3 (iv) would give k = +24. The design and the engine plan treat the fermionic sign as open and 'fix' the tree sign by positivity (G0.1, open_items[0]), but the sign is determined by the definition; an engine that computes the one-loop graphs with the literal definition and flips only the tree sign obtains m_zeta, m_20, m_F with the wrong sign, which corrupts T1 (s' - conj q' = m_20 - m_20'), T2 (s - conj q = m_zeta - m_K) and T3 (i), (ii) (U, V carry n_zeta, n_F). tp eq:t-ward has the expectation-form sign although tp def:t-2pt is the t1 t2 coefficient.
findings.evidence: a3_results.json G1: coefficient of t1 t2 O1 O2 in (t1 O1)(t2 O2) is -1 for odd O1, O2; Ward-sign table: for |Y| = 1 the t1t2 form has the sign opposite to the hypothesis of Thm c8-adjoint, the expectation form agrees. G2: the expectation value on O_zeta is +24 hbar dim g (conj zeta, zeta')/(16 pi^4) (positive, x-independent, with the verified Theta_I of a2), so Def c8-2pt gives -24. Prop ip-tree's own derivation (tree adjointness + tau sigma = -2) forces n_zeta/n_K = 2/|tau|^2 > 0, which holds for the expectation form and fails for the literal definition. G4: k = -24 with the positive norm, +24 with the literal one.

For the inversion R^2 I in the sphere of radius R the radial Gram of an operator of scaling dimension w+kappa is R^{-2(w+kappa)} times that of the unit sphere, not R^{+2(w+kappa)}. Hence a multiplication of the Gram on weight w by 1 + 2c unit w (the normalisation U = 1 + c unit w of Thm ip-P (iii)) corresponds to log R = -c unit, not +c unit; with the normalisation of Thm ip-laws (a) to which the Remark refers (U = 1 + 2c unit w, Gram multiplied by 1 + 4c unit w) it is log R = -2c unit; and the change ell -> lambda ell of (e) (Gram multiplied by lambda^{2 kappa}) corresponds to R = 1/lambda relative to the unit of epsilon.
findings.evidence: a3_results.json G5: lim_{x->0} (R^2/|x|^2)^Delta c |R^2 x/|x|^2|^{-2 Delta} = c R^{-2 Delta}.
findings.fix: Replace 'is $R^{2(w+\kappa)}$ times that of the unit sphere. The inner direction of Theorem \ref{thm:ip-laws} (a) is the classical part $R^{2w}$, $\log R=c\,\unit$, and the change of $\ell$ in (e) is the one-loop part $R^{2\kappa}$' by 'is $R^{-2(w+\kappa)}$ times that of the unit sphere. The basis change $1+c\,\unit\,w$ of Theorem \ref{thm:ip-P} (iii) is the classical part $R^{-2w}$ with $\log R=-c\,\unit$ (the inner direction of Theorem \ref{thm:ip-laws} (a), $U=1+2c\,\unit\,w$, has $\log R=-2c\,\unit$), and the change of $\ell$ in (e) is the one-loop part $R^{-2\kappa}$ with $R=\lambda^{-1}$'.

findings.location: ch08 Thm c8-L (iv) (line 216), Def c8-components (line 233), Thm c8-adjoint (line 505)
findings.claim: The symbol |O| is used for two gradings. In Lambda^(1)(x)O = (-1)^{|O|(1+|x|)}{S^(1)(x),O} it must be the ghost number (degree in C^* in arity zero): with |O| the total parity (the reading suggested by ch02 Def c2-cochains, 'an element of degree 0 has values of parity k + sum|x_i|', and by the graded symmetry of Def c1-bracket), on a fermionic operator such as O_zeta and even x,y one gets Lambda^(1)(x) = -{S^(1)(x),-} and [Lambda^(1)(x),Lambda^(1)(y)] = +Lambda^(1)([x,y]), contradicting Cor c8-homotopy (ii). In the Ward identity of Thm c8-adjoint, |F| must instead be the total parity (with the ghost number, 0 for all operators considered, the sign would be wrong for odd F and odd Y). The design uses the consistent readings (T3 (iv): -Lambda^(1)(Delta)O_zeta = -(5 + 2k unit)O_zeta).
findings.evidence: Direct computation from Cor c8-homotopy (ii) (mod hbar identity [{S^(1)(x),-},{S^(1)(y),-}] = -{S^(1)([x,y]),-} - ...), for even x, y on an odd O.
findings.fix: Thm c8-L (iv): replace '$\Lambda^{(1)}(x)O=(-1)^{|O|(1+|x|)}\{S^{(1)}(x),O\}$' by '$\Lambda^{(1)}(x)O=(-1)^{\mathrm{gh}(O)(1+|x|)}\{S^{(1)}(x),O\}$ with $\mathrm{gh}(O)$ the ghost number (on local functionals of ghost number $0$, of either Grassmann parity, $\Lambda^{(1)}(x)=\{S^{(1)}(x),-\}$)', and in Thm c8-adjoint add 'where $|F|$, $|Y|$ denote total parities'.

not_refuted: The conjugation on psl(4|4) (involution, anti-automorphism, (Q^i_alpha)^dag = -S^alpha_i, (Qbar)^dag = Sbar, P_b^dag = -K_bbar, Delta^dag = Delta, real form psu(2,2|4), uniqueness up to e^{tB}), the reflection dagger_n and the identity X^dag = Ad(C)((Ad(C)^{-1}X)^{dag_n}), the field realisations Theta_n (exact, pointwise) and Theta_I (pointwise up to the stated total derivative), the kernel compatibility of P and K_t, the Gram relation of Cor c8-gram in the coefficient-column convention and its graded form, and the two-component forms checked here are correct. No wrong claim of exact reflection invariance was found: Theta_n is an exact symmetry of S, S^(1), S^(2), P, K_t; Theta_I is not (scalar kinetic total derivative), as stated.
